resources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single original decorative emblem asset for the native Android hydroponics app HydroMate, not a screen mockup. Square composition on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Subject: a small botanical seedling with two richly detailed natural green leaves, visible fine veins, tiny dew drops and wet glossy highlights, growing partly through a clear cyan glass water-drop capsule / slightly spherical bubble. No soil or opaque pot. Strong Frutiger Aero / Frutiger Eco early-2000s optimistic ecological technology character. The glass is physically thick, transparent, polished and aquatic with light cyan rim, bright white specular reflections, subtle refraction and a soft contact shadow. Leaves must look organic and photoreal, not geometric or clay. Broad studio light from upper left, moderate front three-quarter perspective, bright fresh lime/leaf greens and aqua, restrained complexity readable at 90 dp. One centered subject occupies 80 percent of square; generous clean transparent margins. No lettering, numbers, text, logos, UI, gauges, water-level marks, status indicators, watermark, checkerboard pixels, background rectangle, matte plastic, cartoon face, purple neon or dark background.

resources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / local asset refinement.
Edit the supplied HydroMate icon into an OPTICALLY SIMPLIFIED NAVIGATION VARIANT. Reference is the existing icon to preserve its identity and quality. User likes the large photoreal Frutiger Aero icons but ONLY the navigation icons at 34-36 dp need a middle ground between photographic complexity and over-simple flat pictograms.
Keep the distinctive little glass greenhouse/house and the single living green seedling inside. Make the roof and outer house silhouette strong and broad. Simplify to four substantial glass walls/roof planes; no window crosshatching, chimney, roof grooves, miniature hinges, microscopic stems or leaf veins. Give the two leaves a rich readable green. Keep the object dimensional, rounded beveled cyan glass; not a flat generic house.
Keep real dimensional thickness, smooth tinted translucent glass, a rich clear silhouette, soft contact shadow, upper-left soft studio light and convincing three-quarter 3D volume. Reduce internal refraction and texture drastically: broad calm color areas, restrained bright reflection, a single clear dark blue contour. It must look polished and Frutiger Aero, not cartoon, clipart, matte plastic, wireframe, flat vector or clay.
At a 36 dp size the entire silhouette must be recognizable immediately. Clear separation of color zones; no white noisy web of reflections. Do not add patterns, sparkles or tiny details. Cyan blue glass, natural green accents. Preserve object's proportions while simplifying unnecessary detail.
Exactly one centered isolated object. Square transparent alpha canvas, entirely visible with 10% clean margin. No words, digits, lettering, frame, UI, backdrop rectangle, checkerboard pixels or watermark. Background fully transparent.
